name: mw-cross-border-tax
description: Malawi cross-border tax research for the intended 2026 intake, covering the cited domestic source rules, the distinction between nonresident final tax and permanent-establishment income, conditional withholding workpapers, and foreign-tax credit limitations. Use it for overseas suppliers, foreign companies, payments accrued or credited abroad, and the evidence needed before seeking double-tax relief. It traces the effective-management wording inserted in 2023 and deleted in 2024, and distinguishes treaty eligibility from automatic rate relief. This source-based draft does not establish a treaty network, approved treaty rate, current administrative cutover, complete specialist withholding schedule or live filing procedure. Operative-law verification and independent review remain required before any actual payment or filing.
